purpose: Derive exact mixed physical epsilon^2 eta bath parent Ward term from the frozen NL0B completed-square physical U=sqrt(eta)q action, including the frozen GE05-to-GE06 factor 2, and repair the FORMAL interpretation of the previous H4F2b/H4F3d2 unrescaled integer-eta parent template without changing any frozen result or H4 source row.

exact_source_conventions.physical_covariant_memory: L_mem(U,X;eta)=1/4 sum_j[(D_A U_j)^2-(omega_j U_j-sqrt(eta*w_j)*X)^2], with orthogonality A.U_j=0
exact_source_conventions.field_redefinition: U_j=sqrt(eta)*q_j for eta>=0, so L_mem=eta*L_red(q,X), L_red exactly frozen GE05 per-node reduced Lagrangian, plus consistently rescaled auxiliary multiplier if present
exact_source_conventions.mapping: GE05 raw bath EL to GE06 raw Euler convention exact common scale 2, established Repair32A; so L_bath_GE06=2*eta*L_red in GE06 raw action units
exact_source_conventions.bath_scalar_spatial_relabeling: delta q_j=xi*q_j,x derived by H4F1 from U_j=q_j*s_mu; eta scalar parameter
exact_source_conventions.regular_first_order_parent: q_j(eps,eta)=eps[q_j10+eta*q_j11]+eps^2[q_j20+eta*q_j21]/2+... after U_j=sqrt(eta) q_j; at epsilon=0 q_j=0
exact_source_conventions.signed_ward_parent: W_q=2*eta*sum_j E_qj_red*q_j,x in common GE06 action normalization
exact_source_conventions.physical_mixed_derivative: partial_eta partial_epsilon^2 W_q|epsilon=eta=0 = 4*sum_j E_qj10_red*q_j10,x; no factor-of-2 ambiguity and no explicit q_j20/q_j11 contribution
exact_source_conventions.on_shell: The displayed mixed parent term vanishes if every frozen first-order normalized GE05 oscillator E_qj10_red=0, but must remain in the off-shell identity and in the physical discrete error budget.

tests: Verify exact frozen NL0B sqrt(eta) action and rescaling statement and actual GE05 L_red action binding without module-level output-generation side effects.
Prove L_mem(U=sqrt(eta)q)=eta L_red(q) exactly for arbitrary field gradients and eta>=0, and show variations E_U=sqrt(eta) E_q_red at eta>0.
Prove GE06 raw factor-2 mapped parent Ward equals 2 eta E_q_red q_x, with eta frozen as a scalar under diffeomorphisms.
Compute exact mixed epsilon2 eta1 derivative with nonzero arbitrary q10,q11,q20,q21 and Euler e10,e11,e20,e21; coefficient equals 4 e10 q10_x independent q11,q20 and q21.
Prove first-order bath Euler source bound to actual frozen GE05 per-node action, zero homogeneous q and X background and correct theta time derivative; no first-order H3G q20 Euler product.

Add negative controls: omitting explicit eta gives zero mixed parent if q11=e11=0; treating E10/q10 as ordinary eta analytic gives a different coefficient; omitting GE05 factor two halves the coefficient.
All outputs analytic or manufactured only; no actual corrected parent grids, no Z21 solve, no fitted source/residual threshold.
